question: Can the AGI Candidate and Trust Governor be calibrated toward neutral win share across the complete three-, four-, and five-player opponent ecology without changing physical rules, faction starts, Core Actions, or declared strategy identity?

sharedContract.candidateSelection: Minimize the largest absolute miss from 1/player-count, then the mean miss, then ordinary simulation fitness. Every candidate receives identical seeds within a generation and the match budget is distributed over all six circular opponent windows.

jobs.identityGate: The selected candidate must retain AGI Dossier as its largest Program weight, mean score of at least 14 at every supported player count, and an AGI-focused action policy. Final identity remains subject to the fresh holdout AGI winner-credit gate.

The selected candidate must retain explicit Influence and scrutiny-removal preferences and mean score of at least 16 at every supported player count. Final identity remains subject to fresh holdout Influence, Trust, and Mandate gates.

selectionRule.nomination: A training champion may be frozen for holdout only if it improves the maximum neutral-share miss over its generation-zero baseline and passes its profile identity gate.
selectionRule.rejection: Reject a champion that abandons the named strategy, misses its score floor, or merely transfers strength between supported player counts.
selectionRule.holdout: No training result changes canonical profiles. Nominated candidates must be committed with exact report hashes before one fresh-seed unified ecology holdout.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Training cannot select starting resources, Core Actions, Dossier costs, scoring changes, or other physical rules. Any remaining mechanical defect requires a separately preregistered one-lever study.

knownLimits: Deterministic weighted and greedy policies are modelled strategy probes, not human players.
Training candidates share generations and may overfit despite opponent-window coverage.
Simulation cannot establish fun, negotiation quality, teachability, or physical handling.
